profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at GEICO
profile.summary:
Over nineteen years of successful software development experience with developing enterprise software at all levels from concept to production, including development, design, QA, production, and maintenance. Proficient at catching small problems before grow to be big problems that result in business loss. Skilled with computer security, multi-tier systems, health care HIPPA, Federal, market trading, and DoD software requirements.

Specialties: .NET, C#, C++, ASP.NET, SQL, InstallShield, Object Oriented Programming, XML, Oracle Application Developer, skills combined with strong writing, speaking, and business knowledge to build dependable software.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Providing expertise in MVC 5, VS-2013, porting existing GEICO sales web pages to work on iPhones, iPads, and other mobile devices using my expertise in Responsive Web Design and jQuery plug-ins. Additionally providing advanced .NET C# modules that use Web API, WCF, and Team Foundation integration automation.

positions.title: .NET Software Developer
positions.description: Developing software to support worldwide research studies for healtcase, science & technology, energy & environment, education. Westat is a research corportation that offers expertise in Research Design & Analysis, Evaluation, Data Collection & Management, Strategic Communications, and Information Systems.Technologies used include VS2013, C#, MVC5, Entity Framework, jQuery, Ajax, Zurb, Bootstrap

positions.title: .NET Web Developer
positions.description: Working as a temporary web developer to create a new enterprise wide dashboard to assist to improve business processes for the enterprise. Technologies used include VS2012, C#, MVC4, Entity Framework, jQuery, Ajax, Zurb

company.name: URS Corporation via SNI Technologies Inc.

positions.title: .NET Software Developer
positions.description: Developing software to modernize the U.S. Military Healthcare System AHLTA helping 9.2 million beneficiaries including active and retired military and their dependents. This new system will be the largest global healthcare system in the world, using the latest database and software development tools. C#, VB.NET, XML, VB6, SQL, Win32, C++, Security, InstallShield, InstallScript, Ant, NAnt, TFS, and also the team AGILE Build Master

company.name: Forgentum Inc as part of SAIC team

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Research and Development
positions.description: At a $17B Fortune 500 company,  developed and maintained enterprise Content Management software for a $40 Million international commercial application for other large enterprise customers. Developed software to resolve issues and corrected software that affected hundreds of clients in production environments. Coded in C++,C#, SQL, XML, ASP.NET, VB.NET, VB6, TWAIN,TFS

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed enterprise wide applications and executive web portals for a fast growing fixed rate electricity and gas supplier. Personally created an enterprise Web Portal for Sr. Management to view all new customer information and monitor the business workflow in real time at the individual or group level. I also developed automated objects to verify the accuracy of new customer enrollments and capture or recommend corrections before they became problems, which significantly reduced enrollment and boosted customer and management satisfaction. ORACLE Application Express, ORACLE PL/SQL,XML,.NET, C#, C++, UNIX shell scripts

positions.title: Projects Officer - Telemedicine
positions.description: As a civilian U.S. Army contractor with IAP World Services, I managed telemedicine projects at the Walter Reed Army Medical Center in Washington, D.C. for the advancement of military medicine. I performed additional roles as systems analyst and information systems expert to military medical researchers. .NET, C#, ASP.NET, JAVA,, VB.NET, XML, VB6, SQL, Win32, ORACLE PL/SQL, SQL SERVER, ACCESS

company.name: Johnson Controls as part of Walter Reed Army Medical Center team

positions.title: Sr. Web Application Developer - HEALTHeFORCES
positions.description: As part of team, I developed web pages to support military medicine HEALTHeForces web site that interfaces into the Clinical Health Computer System (CHCS). C#, ASP.NET, VB.NET, XML, VB6, SQL, Win32, C++, ORACLE PL/SQL

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Developed effective websites for minority and women owned small business. Provided technical expertise to allow them to give them a presence in the eCommerce area.C#, ASP.NET, VB.NET, XML, VB6, SQL, Win32, C++, ORACLE PL/SQL, SQL SERVER

positions.title: Sr. Systems Architect
positions.description: Managed a team of software developers to develop new power trading systems for a newly deregulated power industry. Performed executive briefings, developed technology objectives and standards. In addition, I personally wrote several new systems for risk management, next day generation bids for powerplants, and developed business to business software interfaces with ZAI*NET and Plant Interface (PI). NET, C#, ASP.NET, JAVA,, VB.NET, XML, VB6, SQL, Win32, ORACLE PL/SQL, SQL SERVER, ACCESS

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - Enterprise Applications
positions.description: While working in the Enterprise Application Development department of the NASDAQ parent company, I developed several new systems leading to reliability and performance improvements for a Kerberos based Ticket Server Gateway and enterprise wide Login Client. I designed and developed the first NASDAQ secure web system (MFQS) that allowed mutual fund companies to securely upload daily prices using X509 client and server digital certificates and windows security. ASP.NET, C++,Win32, XML, VB6, SQL, ORACLE PL/SQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: USUHS - the Department of Defense medical school, the F. Edward Hébert School of Medicine is located in Bethesda, Maryland on the campus of the Walter Reed National Military Medical Center (formerly the National Naval Medical Center Bethesda). Developed new information systems for the medical university registrars and admissions offices allowing multi-user access at the same time, automatic report generation. Additionally created new software for the Anatomy, Microbiology, Pharmacy, and Laboratory Animal departments resulting in significant improvements in manageability and efficiency. For my work, I received a Department of Defense medal for commendable service to the university.ASP.NET, C++,Win32, XML, VB6, SQL, ORACLE PL/SQL, ACCESS
